summary: Turn agricultural market evidence and seasonal costs into a practical venture plan. Explore the five-day agriculture entrepreneurship course.
lede: Agriculture entrepreneurship training helps early-stage agripreneurs and advisers test farm and agribusiness ideas and shape them into practical business plans. Participants practise customer discovery, map value chains, assess enterprise budgets and seasonal cash flow, and design low-cost field experiments before preparing a concise plan and pitch.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who work directly with agricultural enterprises or help them assess commercial opportunities. It is designed for early-stage practitioners and advisers who need to turn production and market information into practical venture documents.
modules: Business Model Canvas for Farm Ventures
prerequisites: Basic numeracy and familiarity with an agricultural activity, product, or value chain are useful. No coding or programming is required.
